brief: Temple-front Greek Revival frame house: gable end to the street, full-height portico of slender Doric columns under a plain pediment, raised on a stone basement with steps up to the entrance. The original is a larger town mansion, reduced here to the lot's footprint with the portico kept. One of the oldest houses in town, on a leafy corner lot near the falls.

facade.notes: the Colby-Jeffery House (1839): a Greek temple front of four giant columns under a full pediment with a lunette-like attic window, flush-board walls, on a high coursed-stone basement with its own door; set on the sidewalk at a corner; a window air-conditioner

why.note: the 1830s temple house of a prospering river town
the raised stone basement: Ohio River floods
